summary: For HTTP registry delivery, download the Ansible plug-ins for Red Hat Developer Hub Setup Bundle (`ansible-rhdh-plugins-x.y.z.tar.gz`), set `$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR` and extract it there with `tar --exclude='*code*'`, giving the backstage-rhaap and scaffolder-backend-module .tgz files with .integrity files.
questions: Where do I download the Ansible plug-ins for RHDH tarball?
How do I extract the ansible-rhdh-plugins tarball?
What files are in the Ansible RHDH plug-ins bundle?
